Report project classification, requester/recipient identity, requests and status as context, not automatically as DECISION. DECISION needs an explicitly adopted choice or agreement; COMMITMENT needs an accepted personal promise. For example, billing and migration are separate projects is context; we agreed to keep them separate records a decision. Test deployment is not client acceptance. Use confirmed, agreed, approved or accepted only for the corresponding evidenced act; otherwise report the status neutrally and preserve what remains unconfirmed. Preserve the supported context and material uncertainty together without restating the same facts across sections.
